sql:
SELECT o_orderpriority, count(*) AS late_orders
FROM orders o
WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-10-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01'
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lineitem l
              WHERE l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey AND l.l_receiptdate > l.l_commitdate + 30)
GROUP BY o_orderpriority

A semi-join is used to efficiently filter orders that have at least one late lineitem.
Sequential scan is chosen for the orders table due to the date range filter.
Hash table for the semi-join build side.
Sequential scan of lineitem to find all late items.

Aggregate (Sorted, Finalize) over (orders, lineitem): PostgreSQL uses Sorted aggregation, the AI uses Hashed. Hashed aggregation needs no sorted input but more memory. Sorted aggregation needs sorted input but little memory. The AI's reason: "The query requires grouping by order priority and counting, using a hash aggregate for efficiency."

The join of (orders, lineitem): PostgreSQL uses Nested Loop of (orders) with (lineitem). The AI uses Hash Join of (orders) with (lineitem). Hash join suits large inputs. Nested loop suits a small outer input, especially with an index on the inner side. Merge join suits sorted inputs. The AI's reason: "A semi-join is used to efficiently filter orders that have at least one late lineitem."

Table lineitem: PostgreSQL uses Index Scan on lineitem using lineitem_pkey. The AI uses Seq Scan on lineitem. A sequential scan wins when many rows qualify. An index scan wins when few rows qualify. A bitmap scan sits in between. The AI's reason: "Sequential scan of lineitem to find all late items."
Only the PostgreSQL plan has Gather Merge over (orders, lineitem) (collects sorted rows from parallel workers, keeping the order).
Only the PostgreSQL plan has Aggregate (Sorted, Partial) over (orders, lineitem) (computes aggregates (GROUP BY, SUM, COUNT, ...)).
Only the PostgreSQL plan has Sort over (orders, lineitem) (sorts its input).
Only the AI plan has Hash over (lineitem) (builds the in-memory hash table for a Hash Join). The AI's reason: "Hash table for the semi-join build side."
